up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for Mus musculus (tax_id = 10090). Return the substrate canonical SMILES structure, substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, and enzyme name. Use substrate_record_id for the substrate identification and structure, and drug_record_id for the parent compound name.
sql:
WITH metabolism_data AS (
  SELECT
    m.met_id,
    m.pathway_key,
    m.met_conversion,
    m.enzyme_name,
    m.substrate_record_id,
    m.drug_record_id
  FROM metabolism m
  WHERE m.tax_id = 10090
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  cr_drug.compound_name AS parent_compound_name,
  md.met_conversion,
  md.pathway_key,
  md.enzyme_name
FROM metabolism_data md
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON md.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_drug ON md.drug_record_id = cr_drug.record_id;
